title: 零售只涨1.1%？：剔除汽车却达2.8%，核心地段租金还在涨
speaker: Helm Linger

segments.en: Thanks for having me, man I would say that, you know, the retail is holding steady Right, and actually there's a bit of momentum lately
segments.zh: 谢谢邀请。我想说，零售市场保持稳定，而且近期有一些动能。

segments.en: Because if you look at the overall total retail sales consumptions It's doing about 1.1 percent yet to date But if you exclude automobile, it's up to 2.8 percent
segments.zh: 因为看整体零售销售，今年迄今增长约1.1%，但剔除汽车后，增幅达到2.8%。

segments.en: And now if you look into September alone, it's plus 3.9 percent All right Now, look at services, for instance, is doing plus 5 percent
segments.zh: 单看9月份，增长了3.9%。再看服务业，增长了5%。

segments.en: That's huge Which means that Chinese consumers are into experience By that I mean travel, you know, hospitality, shows, entertainment and sport
segments.zh: 这很可观，意味着中国消费者注重体验，比如旅游、酒店、演出、娱乐和体育。

segments.en: So there's definitely some good news ahead Now, if you look at the overall real estate situation How does it translate?
segments.zh: 所以前景肯定有一些好消息。那么整体房地产情况如何体现呢？

segments.en: Well overall, I would say that, you know, in the major cities, tier 1 and tier 2 We see a vacancy rate that's pretty stable 7.5 percent, more or less
segments.zh: 总体而言，在一二线主要城市，我们看到空置率相当稳定，大约在7.5%左右。

segments.en: Right But it's a double speed market But I mean that prime real estate is in high demand
segments.zh: 但这是一个双速市场，我的意思是优质房地产需求旺盛。

segments.en: And we actually see some rental growth in Shanghai and Beijing specifically While suburbs and decentralized locations are under pressure
segments.zh: 我们看到上海和北京的租金有所增长，而郊区和分散区域则面临压力。

segments.en: And by that I mean that we have a lot of incoming supply For instance, 2027 will see about 4.4 million square meter
segments.zh: 这意味着有大量新增供应，例如2027年将有约440万平方米。

segments.en: In being injected across 8 major cities But that will decrease up to 2.8 million And then 1.9 million square meter
segments.zh: 这些供应将注入8个主要城市，但之后将减少到280万和190万平方米。

segments.en: Right Among that, only 11 percent of it is actually prime real estate Which means that, you know, all the core downtown retail sectors
segments.zh: 其中，只有11%是核心优质物业，这意味着所有市中心核心零售板块

segments.en: Will be protected and shall see rental growth So, how close do you think are we from the bottom of rental prices now
segments.zh: 将受到保护并迎来租金增长。那么，您认为我们现在离租金底部还有多远？
